title: Positive mass theorem and the Yamabe equation on CR manifolds
summary: Our goal is to survey the development of positive mass theorem and the Yamabe equation on CR manifolds in recent years. We introduce the notion of the mass in several complex variables or CR geometry. We then consider the Yamabe problem on CR manifolds to find a minimizer for the CR-Sobolev quotient. The positive mass theorem plays a key role in finding a solution to the Yamabe equation with minimum energy for the positive curvature case.
